title: Settings
subtitle: Make your practice space work for you.
aiIntro: Configure each service you want to use, then choose a model for generating articles. Keys stay in this browser and are sent only to the corresponding official service.
help: If you do not have an API key or need help setting one up, contact the author on WeChat: <contact>Altria1979</contact>.
showRomajiHelp: Show the letters you can type next.
showKanaHelp: Show readings above kanji in articles.
showTranslationHelp: Show sentence-by-sentence meanings during article practice.
dataHelp: Articles, practice history and preferences are stored only in this browser. They cannot be restored automatically after changing devices or clearing site data. No registration or cloud sync is used.
readError: Unable to read model settings. Check this site’s storage permissions.
invalidModel: The model ID is empty or invalid. Your selection has not been saved.
saveError: Your model selection could not be saved. Check browser storage permissions and retry.
